comment: Drives the buildhost site deploy (.github/workflows/preview.yml runs .github/scripts/assemble-pages.ts, which assembles _site/ from this file and publishes it to sites.pazer.build; nothing else decides what gets published). Each {from, to} entry copies a repo file or directory (recursive) to a site output path rooted at https://sites.pazer.build/scratch_ui/branch/master/ (or the matching pr-<n> branch site). Sources live per component (src/components/<name>/<name>.ts + .css) and compile to dist/<name>/<name>.js, but the PUBLISHED surface is flat — external consumers embed root-relative URLs like /scratch-button.js, the js-snippets convention — so each component gets an explicit flattening entry here. assemble-pages.ts fails when a component has no such entry, so a new component cannot be silently left unpublished. The spec site is served under /demo/ and src/index.html forwards the site root to it.
